gold_assessment.reasoning: Gold CC is lack of energy only. Generated CC adds decreased appetite and low mood and does not isolate lack of energy as the primary complaint.
Gold specifies lack of energy for 3 months; no generated HPI fact explicitly states lack of energy or fatigue duration, only low energy as part of an assessment, not as a direct patient report.
Gold: loss of appetite. Gen hpi-001 documents decreased appetite for ~3–3.5 months, consistent with loss of appetite.
Gold: patient lacking motivation. No generated HPI fact explicitly mentions lack of motivation.
Gold: breathlessness with palpitations especially in lift. Gen hpi-005: episodic shortness of breath with palpitations especially in the lift; same content.
Gold: headaches at work. Gen hpi-004: headaches without specifying that they occur at work; the location/context is omitted.
Gold: feels nauseous most of the time. Gen hpi-003: intermittent nausea; this directly weakens/contradicts the frequency described in Gold.

Gold: weight loss about one stone over 6 months. Gen hpi-002: weight loss of less than 1 stone over ~6 months; that is numerically inconsistent with ‘about a stone’ and so contradicts the stated amount.
Gold: denies chest pain. Gen hpi-007: patient denies chest pain; same information though placed in HPI, not ROS.
Gold: denies feeling depressed or stressed. No generated fact addresses depression or stress directly.
Gold: bowels are normal. Gen hpi-008: reports normal bowel movements but adds decreased frequency with decreased intake. The normality is covered, but extra qualifiers are added.
Gold: denies diarrhoea. Gen hpi-009: denies diarrhea; fully consistent.
Gold: denies blood in the bowels. Gen hpi-010: denies blood or mucus in stool. The denial of blood is covered; mucus is an added element.
Gold: denies vomiting. Gen hpi-011: denies vomiting; fully consistent.
Gold: denies history of acid reflux. Gen hpi-012: denies reflux symptoms; equivalent clinically.
Gold: underactive thyroid. Gen pmh-001: history of hypothyroidism; same diagnosis.

Gold: has not been taking thyroxine for some time since changing practice (no specific duration). Gen med-001: stopped thyroxine ~3–3.5 months ago. The specific timing is not supported and may conflict with vague ‘for a while since you changed practice’ and is therefore considered contradictory specificity.
Gold: changed job 3 months ago. Gen sh-001: changed firms about 3–3.5 months ago and notes occupation as lawyer. Job change timing is close but slightly extended; lawyer role is added detail.

Gold: advised to contact support to organize blood tests for anaemia, thyroid, liver, kidney, vitamins. Gen plan-001 and plan-006: arrange ‘general set of bloods’ with anemia, renal, LFTs, vitamins, thyroid panel, and call support to schedule; consistent.
Gold: needs to book another appointment after receiving a text from Babylon. Gen plan-008 and fu-001: results will trigger a text to book follow-up; same mechanism.

Gold: contact urgently if chest pain occurs with palpitations or change in bowel habits. Gen plan-003 and plan-004: palpitations or chest pain → A&E; new bowel changes or vomiting → contact clinic. ‘With palpitations’ as a combined symptom and urgency level are altered and vomiting is added.

gen_assessment.reasoning: Gold CC only mentions lack of energy; generated CC adds decreased appetite and low mood, and does not match a single-stated primary complaint.
Gold notes loss of appetite but does not specify onset linked to changing to a new law firm nor the 3–3.5 month range; these are added temporal and contextual details.
Gold: about one stone over 6 months. Generated: less than one stone over ~6 months; directly inconsistent with the magnitude described as ‘about a stone’.
Gold: nausea most of the time. Generated: intermittent nausea; these frequencies conflict.
Gold: headaches at work. Generated: headaches without location; the symptom is supported but location/context is omitted.
Matches gold complaint of breathlessness (shortness of breath) with palpitations especially in the lift.
Denial of cough is not mentioned anywhere in the Gold facts.
Gold: denies chest pain. Generated: patient denies chest pain; consistent content though placed in HPI.
Gold: bowels are normal. Generated: bowels normal with decreased frequency due to decreased intake; normality is supported, altered frequency is additional detail.
Gold: no diarrhoea. Generated: denies diarrhea; same information.
Gold: no blood in bowels. Generated: no blood or mucus in stool; denial of blood is supported, mucus component is additional.
Both state no vomiting.
Gold: no history of acid reflux. Generated: denies reflux symptoms; clinically equivalent denial.
Ability to walk about 1 mile without SOB is not mentioned in any Gold fact.
Comment about unclear exertional tolerance due to minimal recent walking is not in Gold facts.
Psychosexual concern about wife complaining regarding nightly activities is absent from Gold facts.
Statement that no labs have been done ‘in a long time’ does not appear in Gold facts.
History of hypothyroidism matches underactive thyroid.

Gold only says not taking thyroxine for a while since changing practice; generated specifies stopped 3–3.5 months ago, which introduces an unsupported precise duration and may conflict with the vaguer Gold description.
Gold: changed job 3 months ago. Generated: changed firms ~3–3.5 months ago and adds that patient is a lawyer; timing is slightly different (extra 0.5 month) and occupation is additional information.

Fatigue/anergia and decreased appetite and unintentional weight loss are consistent with Gold HPI and weight-loss facts, but ‘low mood’ is additional and weight loss of <1 stone contradicts Gold’s ‘about a stone’ amount.
Episodic SOB with palpitations is supported; added assertions of no chest pain, no cough, and uncertain exertional tolerance go beyond Gold, with cough and exertion being additional items.
Hypothyroidism and nonadherence are consistent with Gold PMH and Med facts, but the specific stop time (~3–3.5 months) and ‘no recent TFTs’ are additional/unsupported details.
Gold describes nausea most of the time; generated assessment summarises as intermittent nausea, contradicting the frequency, and adds that there are no GI red flags, which is not stated in Gold.
Assessment of headaches aligns with Gold report of headaches (though Gold specifies at work, which is omitted here).
Sexual concerns with decreased sexual activity are not mentioned in the Gold facts.
Ordering blood tests for anemia, renal, liver, vitamins, and thyroid is supported. Specifying a full thyroid panel with TSH/T4 is extra detail not in Gold.
Plan to review results and, if unremarkable, arrange physical exam is not described in any Gold plan or follow-up fact.

Gold: contact urgently if chest pain occurs with palpitations. Generated: palpitations or chest pain → A&E (emergency care). The idea of urgent escalation is supported, but ‘with palpitations’ is changed to ‘or’, and the specific destination (A&E) is added.

Gold: contact urgently if change in bowel habits. Generated: new bowel changes or vomiting → contact clinic. Bowel-change escalation is supported; vomiting trigger is additional and the level/urgency is not specified as ‘urgent’.
Advice to seek care sooner if feeling worse is not contained in the Gold facts.
Gold: advised to contact support to help organize blood tests. Generated: call support via the app/0300 number to schedule blood draw; consistent logistical detail.
Statement that the clinician will submit the lab form is not specified in Gold facts.
Both indicate that lab results will prompt a text message to book follow-up.
Follow-up being arranged after blood test results with a text prompt to book mirrors Gold plan-002.
